visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md. The KB-era index.html that used to sit in this directory was DELETED 2026-08-27: it was retired as a visual target on 2026-08-26 and kept only because ci:mockup-coverage required a parity.json beside any index.html, which is a gate keeping a dead file alive. The target is the patterns in PUBLIC_UI.md, built from components/site/v3. THIS FILE STILL BINDS: requiredComponents is what stops a page silently losing a section, and ci:mockup-parity reads it with or without a mockup.
competitiveTarget: Utility comparison page: side-by-side property table. noindex — not an SEO surface. The landing state is the competitive surface: Redfin and Zillow open their compare screens on the visitor's own saved thumbnails, and this page has no saved-homes rail to open on. It wins instead by showing the finished object to a visitor who arrives with nothing — four real homes for sale right now, in the real table, labelled as an example, each one a single tap into their own comparison.
note: E-HOMES-SEARCH 2026-08-13. Migrated /compare chrome onto the v3 barrel. Chrome: layout mounts V3Chrome (sticky, in flow). This page does not remount it. V3Breadcrumb belowNav=false. V3Footer outside <main>. Page contract carried unchanged: robots noindex,follow, revalidate 60, canonical /compare, DAL fetch (getListingTiles by listNumbers AND listingKeys, dedup, getListingDetailPhotos), CompareClient props, BreadcrumbList JSON-LD, V3SectionTracker pageType=compare. Shared /compare?ids= links keep resolving. Dual objectives unchanged. Capture does not live on this route. KB-era deletions: SmoothScrollProvider, KbBreadcrumb, KbFooter, kb-root, kb.css, navy header band. AICompare deleted 2026-08-18 (never wired). MetadataBlock and KbSectionTracker stay on non-v3 registers. SITE-50 (2026-09-09): the empty state left V3Quiet for V3Slots, a new barrel pattern. The taste table scored this class 29 with the verdict 'an empty form label, not a product demo'; Quiet has no slot, no table and no figure by contract, so the fix could never be a prop on Quiet. Two more defects were fixed in the same change: the H1 sat in a bare <header> with no measure and no gutter and was clipped at x=0 at both 1440 and 375, and the visually-hidden spans inside the new table escaped their scroll container (no positioned ancestor) and made the document scroll sideways at 375 — html.scrollWidth 602 against a 375 viewport.

requiredComponents.name: MetadataBlock
requiredComponents.section: JSON-LD — BreadcrumbList structured data (Home > Compare). No WebPage JSON-LD on a noindex utility route.

requiredComponents.name: V3Breadcrumb
requiredComponents.section: Home / Compare homes. Surface tone, belowNav=false because chrome is sticky in flow.

requiredComponents.name: V3Heading
requiredComponents.section: H1 Compare homes on the POPULATED page, inside a masthead that carries the section measure and gutter. On the empty page V3Slots carries the H1 itself.

requiredComponents.name: CompareEmpty
requiredComponents.section: #compare-empty — the empty state, which mounts V3Slots and binds it to ComparisonContext so the slots show the visitor's own tray and an add from the example lands in the same list a search-result add does.

requiredComponents.name: V3Quiet
requiredComponents.section: #compare-empty fallback — when the live example read returns nothing there is no example to show, so the page opens with its own name and the way to fill it rather than a half-drawn table.

requiredComponents.name: CompareClient
requiredComponents.section: interactive comparison surface — photo row, side-by-side feature table with best-in-class highlighting, Google Maps locations embed, Copy Link + Download PDF actions, empty/loading state

layoutComponents.name: V3Chrome
layoutComponents.section: renders from app/layout.tsx, position:sticky in flow
layoutComponents.note: ci:mockup-parity auto-satisfies a V3Chrome requiredComponent via layout. This page does not remount it.

sectionOrder: CompareEmpty -> V3Slots #compare-empty -- the H1, four slots, the labelled worked example (empty queue only)
V3Heading masthead -- the H1 on the populated page only

tasteReview.evaluator: SITE-50 lane, round three. A separate Agent given only TASTE.md, the two shots below and the mark to beat, with no access to the builder's reasoning; it scored the same shots three times in one call. Rounds one and two, against earlier shots of the same rebuild, returned medians 59 and 50; this receipt records round three because these are the shots on disk.
tasteReview.beats: Redfin's and Zillow's compare and saved-homes screens render nothing until the visitor has already saved homes, and once populated they show a flat table with no encoding of the spread and no named source. This page shows a real four-home comparison on first load, with a length under each figure for the rows where the spread is the point and 'Regional MLS through Oregon Data Share' named in the same screen.

defects.finding: the four queue slots are dashed placeholder boxes carrying a numeral and 'Add a home' — the form of a generic dropzone rather than something built for houses
defects.fix: give a slot a photo-aspect seat so an empty one reads as a house-shaped hole, not a form field

defects.finding: the second example column is sliced at the 375 viewport edge; the scroll shadow marks it as a scroller but the cut still reads as a crop before the reader pushes it
defects.fix: size the columns so two sit whole inside 335px, or leave a deliberate half-column peek

defects.finding: the lengths under the figures are static in a still; the row hover that lifts a field across all four homes cannot be seen in a shot, and nothing else in the example rewards a hover
defects.fix: give the example a reveal that survives a screenshot — a per-row reading, or a control that changes which field is drawn

defects.finding: the empty tray and the worked example are two four-across blocks stacked, rather than one object where the example fills the tray it is teaching
defects.fix: consider making the example columns BE the four slots, pre-filled and swappable, instead of an empty set above a demo set

tasteReview.notes: The route had no committed tasteReview before this one, so this is its first receipt and comparedToPrior is 'first'. The class's mark on the STANDING TABLE instrument (design_system/public/taste-table.json, 2026-09-08) was median 29 from scorings 29/34/25, with the verdict 'an empty form label, not a product demo'. That table's shots are not in the repo, so its shotsHash differs and it is not a valid priorMark here — the table's own note says so. On the same rubric, the same evaluator model and the same capture spec, the class now medians 53.
